summary.text: Carl Gilliard represents Georgia House District 162.

paragraphs.text: Gilliard was born in Savannah, Georgia, attended A.E. Beach High School, and later attended Morris Brown College in Atlanta.
Gilliard founded Feed the Hungry Inc., a Georgia nonprofit, and is president of the Georgia Coastal chapter of the Southern Christian Leadership Conference.
